final: WITH matched_executions AS (SELECT oe.ordersmark AS ordersmark, o.timespan AS timespan, oe.fillcount AS fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS oe JOIN orders AS o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault), tif_averages AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS tif_avg_fill FROM matched_executions GROUP BY timespan), order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS order_avg_fill FROM matched_executions GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), ranked_orders AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.timespan, oa.order_avg_fill, oa.order_avg_fill - ta.tif_avg_fill AS excess_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oa.timespan ORDER BY oa.order_avg_fill DESC) AS fill_rank FROM order_averages AS oa JOIN tif_averages AS ta ON oa.timespan IS ta.timespan WHERE oa.order_avg_fill > ta.tif_avg_fill) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_avg_fill, excess_fill, fill_rank FROM ranked_orders WHERE fill_rank <= 3
